title: Car Showroom — Customer Feedback Intake
description: A showroom salesperson conducts an initial feedback session with a customer who recently purchased a vehicle. Follows a structured intake framework.

utterances.speaker: interviewer
utterances.text: Thank you for visiting us today. Could you tell me about your experience with the showroom and the buying process?

utterances.speaker: responder
utterances.text: Sure. I came in last Saturday around 2 PM. The staff greeted me promptly and were very patient while I explored different models.

utterances.speaker: interviewer
utterances.text: Were there any specific staff members who stood out to you for good service?

utterances.speaker: responder
utterances.text: Yes, Alex helped me a lot. He explained the features of the SUV I was interested in and even offered a test drive on short notice.

utterances.speaker: interviewer
utterances.text: That's great to hear. How did you find the selection of vehicles available?

utterances.speaker: responder
utterances.text: There was a good variety, but I was hoping to see more color options for the SUV. Still, the models on display were enough for me to make a decision.

utterances.speaker: interviewer
utterances.text: Did you face any challenges during the purchasing process?

utterances.speaker: responder
utterances.text: Not really, everything went smoothly. Paperwork was a bit longer than expected, but the staff explained everything clearly.

utterances.speaker: interviewer
utterances.text: And what about the delivery of your vehicle? Were you satisfied?

utterances.speaker: responder
utterances.text: Yes, I received my car last Thursday. The showroom gave me a full orientation and checked that everything was in perfect condition.

utterances.speaker: interviewer
utterances.text: How has your experience been with the vehicle itself so far?

utterances.speaker: responder
utterances.text: It's been excellent. Smooth ride, all the features work as described. The navigation system took a little time to get used to, but that’s normal.

utterances.speaker: interviewer
utterances.text: Have you had any service interactions since purchase?

utterances.speaker: responder
utterances.text: No service visits yet, but I did call once with a question about pairing my phone. They were very helpful over the phone.

utterances.speaker: interviewer
utterances.text: Do you have any suggestions for improving our showroom experience?

utterances.speaker: responder
utterances.text: Maybe more seating in the waiting area and a few more demo vehicles for test drives, especially on busy days.

utterances.speaker: interviewer
utterances.text: Thank you, that’s valuable feedback. Overall, would you recommend our showroom to others?

utterances.speaker: responder
utterances.text: Definitely. The staff were professional, patient, and knowledgeable. I had a very positive experience.

utterances.speaker: interviewer
utterances.text: Fantastic. We really appreciate your time and feedback.

utterances.speaker: responder
utterances.text: My pleasure. Thank you for following up with me.
